name: Iceland Farm + South Coast Bookable Loop

dates.why: Aug 31-Sep 13 gives a full South Iceland trip without forcing the Ring Road. Overnight flight lands Sep 1, then the route runs Reykjavik → Golden Circle farm → South Coast → Snaefellsnes → KEF.

exchangeRateNote: Foreign-currency items use planning conversions and must be re-priced before booking.
positioning: Budget-rebalanced Iceland route with farm stays and guesthouses as the default, while keeping Hotel Ranga and Hotel Budir as optional nicer swaps.
routeLabel: KEF → Reykjavik → Golden Circle farm → South Coast → Snæfellsnes
routeRationale: The route is ordered as KEF → Reykjavik → Golden Circle farm → South Coast → Snæfellsnes to reduce backtracking and keep the biggest transfers between lodging bases.
Each base lasts 2-4 nights so the baby has repeated sleep environments instead of daily hotel churn.
High-impact sights are paired with nearby backup options so weather does not break the trip.
The Ryan Shirley/video inspiration is used for idea generation, then validated with official tourism, park, hotel, airline, and activity sources.

budget.note: Reworked to sit near target by using farm/guesthouse lodging as the base plan. Hotel Ranga and Hotel Budir are now marked as upgrades.

recommended.label: Recommended Delta via JFK
recommended.infantNote: International infant-in-lap fee/taxes apply; verify during Delta checkout.
recommended.budgetNote: Planning snapshot keeps the Delta via-JFK KEF routing and fare reference; re-price Aug 31-Sep 13 before booking.

alternates.label: Cash/points alternative
alternates.summary: Re-price on Delta with flexible dates and compare points value before booking.

bases.why: Lets everyone reset with groceries, stroller walks, and services nearby.

bases.hotel: Efstidalur Farm Hotel / nearby farm guesthouse

bases.why: Keeps Skogafoss, Seljalandsfoss, Vik, and weather backups within reach.

bases.name: Snaefellsnes coastal base
bases.why: Gives the dramatic finale without defaulting to Hotel Budir rates.
